requirement: R4 - fair line, market line and difference as separate columns

columns.fair_line: The model's number, from the three-stage origination.
columns.market_line: No consulted official source publishes a price or a point spread for this market (see the nfl.com/odds/ negative result, CP-NFL-ODDS-ABSENT). Blank, not zero.
columns.difference: fair_line minus market_line. Blank whenever the market line is blank; never printed as zero.
columns.fair_price: The model's fair, zero-hold price. Not an offered price.
columns.market_price: No consulted official source publishes a price or a point spread for this market (see the nfl.com/odds/ negative result, CP-NFL-ODDS-ABSENT). Blank, not zero.
columns.price_difference: Blank whenever the market price is blank.

why_the_difference_is_blank: NFL.com returns a 404 at /odds/ and prints no spread, total or price on any page this project read, including the Week 10 game page.

No operator or sportsbook was consulted: the NFL.com terms restrict use of the material to individual non-commercial informational purposes, and the project has no written consent to retrieve prices systematically.
A difference is the whole point of the column, so it is left empty rather than filled with an estimate that would look like an edge.

over_price_derivation.method: P(actual total > model total) from the 121 walk-forward residuals
over_price_derivation.caveat: This measures the model's own tendency to over-forecast totals. It is not a market comparison and not a claim of value.

rows.fair_line_basis: Stage 1. Convention: negative favours the home club. Fair price is +100 because a side covers its own line half the time by construction.
The same stage-1 number, seen from the away club. Fair price +100 for the same reason.
Stage 2: the sum of the stage-1 pair.
Stage 2: the sum of the stage-1 pair.
Stage 3: a moneyline has no points, so the line column is blank by definition and the fair value is carried as a price.
Stage 3: as above, from the away side.
